summary: Stock Yards Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting a routine quarterly dividend increase to $0.33 per share, payable October 1, 2026, to holders of record September 21, 2026. The board approved the increase on August 18, 2026, and a press release was issued the next day. This is an ordinary capital return event, not a special-situation catalyst such as a tender, spin-off, or restructuring. The filing provides no M&A terms, advisors, or unusual mechanics. The company notes 19 dividend increases since 2011 with a 175% cumulative rise.
